Subject: Reminder: Client Confidentiality Policy

Hi Team,

I wanted to take a moment to remind everyone about the importance of maintaining strict confidentiality regarding our clients.

Recently, it was brought to my attention that client details were shared inappropriately. Please remember that sharing any client information with anyone outside of the authorized team is strictly against company policy. This includes sharing details with family members or friends.

We trust in your professionalism and discretion. Please ensure that all client information remains secure and is only discussed within the appropriate professional channels.

Thank you for your cooperation.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
